findings.passage: Also, I strongly believe that we should pre-canvass our mail in ballots in order to obtain quick, accurate voting results.

findings.passage: There was no widespread election fraud in 2020.
findings.note: Same questionnaire answer. He says he saw no widespread fraud in 2020 in Pennsylvania.
